Sections follow the manuscript. 

| | |
|---|---|
| R | ≥ 4.2: `phyloseq`, `vegan`, `dplyr`, `ggplot2`, `patchwork`, `car`, `edgeR`, `DESeq2`, `metagenomeSeq`, `TITAN2`, `ape`; for the optional regenerations `NST`, `picante`, `betapart`, `iCAMP` (`V.PhyloMaker2` optional: the tree is supplied)  
| Data | the Zenodo data record, unpacked as `data/` next to this code folder (repository layout), or anywhere with `PAPER_DATA` set to its `data/` folder   
| Modules | the six `.R` modules sourced in `load-modules`, next to this document. Every other R step is written in this document   <!-- [INT 2] --> |
| From the ASV tables only | `PAPER_FROM_ASV = "true"` regenerates every intermediate result (DA exports, NST and βNTI, TITAN2, iCAMP) from the ASV tables and the two ASV trees, c. 16 h; set it for the notebook too   

Run first, then `Paper_figures.ipynb`.

```{r load-data}
## The two community objects, built from the deposited tables. 
##
build_physeq <- function(otu_f, tax_f, meta_f) {
  otu  <- read.delim(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, otu_f),  row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  tax  <- read.delim(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, tax_f),  row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  meta <- read.csv(  file.path(MATRIX_DIR, meta_f), check.names = FALSE)
  stopifnot(ncol(otu) > 1)          
  rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
  keep <- intersect(colnames(otu), rownames(meta))
  phyloseq(otu_table(as.matrix(otu[, keep]), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
           tax_table(as.matrix(tax[rownames(otu), , drop = FALSE])),
           sample_data(meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]))
}
physeq_bacteria <- build_physeq("otu_bacteria_table_R_1314ASVs.csv",
                                "tax_bacteria_R_1314ASVs.csv",
                                "metadata_bacteria_1314ASVs.csv")
physeq_fungi    <- build_physeq("otu_fungi_table_R_647ASVs.csv",
                                "tax_fungi_R_647ASVs.csv",
                                "metadata_fungi_647ASVs.csv")

## as.data.frame() on a phyloseq sample_data object 
metadata_bacteria <- as(sample_data(physeq_bacteria), "data.frame")
metadata_fungi    <- as(sample_data(physeq_fungi),    "data.frame")
stopifnot(identical(class(metadata_bacteria), "data.frame"))

## metadata (all 30 per-species replicate counts match exactly
SYNONYMS <- c("Centaurea cyanus"    = "Cyanus segetum",
              "Festuca arundinacea" = "Lolium arundinaceum",
              "Bromus sterilis"     = "Anisantha sterilis",
              "Festuca myuros"      = "Lolium arundinaceum",
              "Viola arvensis"      = "Vulpia myuros")
for (m in c("metadata_bacteria", "metadata_fungi")) {
  d <- get(m); hit <- d$species %in% names(SYNONYMS)
  d$species[hit] <- SYNONYMS[d$species[hit]]
  d$species <- factor(d$species)
  assign(m, d)
}
sample_data(physeq_bacteria)$species <- metadata_bacteria$species
sample_data(physeq_fungi)$species    <- metadata_fungi$species
stopifnot(setequal(levels(metadata_bacteria$species),
                   levels(metadata_fungi$species)))

cat(sprintf("bacteria: %d taxa x %d samples\nfungi:    %d taxa x %d samples\n",
            ntaxa(physeq_bacteria), nsamples(physeq_bacteria),
            ntaxa(physeq_fungi), nsamples(physeq_fungi)))
```

# 3.1 Drivers of wheat root microbiota composition

## 3.1.1 Community composition and assembly

### Table 1, Fig. 1b: sequential PERMANOVA

```{r table-1}
bacteria_bray <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_bacteria, "bray")
fungi_bray    <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_fungi,    "bray")

set.seed(1)
bacteria_sequential <- adonis2(bacteria_bray ~ soil * species,
                               data = metadata_bacteria,
                               permutations = NPERM, by = "terms")
set.seed(1)
fungi_sequential    <- adonis2(fungi_bray ~ soil * species,
                               data = metadata_fungi,
                               permutations = NPERM, by = "terms")

tab1 <- permanova_table(list(`Bacteria (rpoB)` = bacteria_sequential,
                             `Fungi (ITS1)`    = fungi_sequential))
write.csv(tab1, file.path(OUT_DIR, "Table1_variance_partition.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
permanova_table_pretty(tab1, nperm = NPERM)
```

### Methods S2: order-independence of Table 1

```{r table-1-order}
## Order-independence of the Table 1 partition (Methods S2).
permanova_order <- function(data_dir, out_csv) {
  set.seed(1)
  res <- list()
  for (kg in c("bacteria", "fungi")) {
    tag <- if (kg == "bacteria") "1314" else "647"
    X <- t(as.matrix(read.delim(file.path(data_dir, sprintf("otu_%s_table_R_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag)), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)))
    m <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, sprintf("metadata_%s_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag))); rownames(m) <- m$sample
    m <- m[rownames(X), ]; D <- vegdist(X, "bray")
    f <- list(published_order = D ~ soil * species, reversed_order = D ~ species * soil)
    for (nm in names(f)) { r <- adonis2(f[[nm]], data = m, permutations = 999, by = "terms")
      res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, model = nm, term = rownames(r), df = r$Df, R2 = r$R2, F = r$F, P = r[["Pr(>F)"]]) }
    r <- adonis2(D ~ soil + species, data = m, permutations = 999, by = "margin")
    res[[length(res) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, model = "marginal_main_effects", term = rownames(r), df = r$Df, R2 = r$R2, F = r$F, P = r[["Pr(>F)"]])
  }
  write.csv(do.call(rbind, res), out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
}
permanova_order(MATRIX_DIR, file.path(SUPP_DIR, "permanova_order_check.csv"))
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(SUPP_DIR, "permanova_order_check.csv")), digits = 4)
```

### Table 1 (within each soil), Fig. S6 tests and the Fig. 4 tests

```{r revision-analyses}
## adonis2 of species within each soil (Methods S2); db-RDA of species-centroid
## composition on species-mean wheat biomass with conditional versions (Fig. 4, Results 3.2.2, Methods S3);
## per-taxon Spearman screen at the same unit; Glomeromycota tests (Fig. S6). 9,999 permutations
REV_DIR <- file.path(SUPP_DIR, "revision")
## =============================================================================
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
##
##   Table 1   within-soil neighbour effect: adonis2(Bray-Curtis ~ species) per kingdom x soil
##   Fig. 4    direct microbiota-growth test: db-RDA of species-centroid composition on species-mean
##             wheat biomass, 28 weeds per kingdom x soil
##   Fig. S6   Glomeromycota share by soil (Wilcoxon, pots) and Fabaceae vs other weeds
##             (Wilcoxon on species means, per soil and pooled)
## =============================================================================
revision_analyses <- function(DATA, OUT, NPERM = 9999) {
  dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE); set.seed(20261102)
  SOILS <- c(resistant = "Cereal-dominated (AF193)", Permissive = "Mixed-system (AF190)")
  CTRL  <- c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat")
  SYN   <- c("Centaurea cyanus" = "Cyanus segetum", "Festuca arundinacea" = "Lolium arundinaceum", "Bromus sterilis" = "Anisantha sterilis")
  LEGUMES <- c("Lotus corniculatus", "Medicago lupulina", "Trigonella foenum-graecum", "Vicia cracca")
  load_kingdom <- function(kg) {
    tag  <- if (kg == "bacteria") "1314" else "647"
    otu  <- read.delim(file.path(DATA, sprintf("otu_%s_table_R_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag)), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
    meta <- read.csv(file.path(DATA, sprintf("metadata_%s_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag)), check.names = FALSE)
    rownames(meta) <- meta$sample; hit <- meta$species %in% names(SYN); meta$species[hit] <- SYN[meta$species[hit]]
    X <- t(as.matrix(otu)); keep <- intersect(rownames(X), rownames(meta))
    list(X = X[keep, ], meta = meta[keep, ])
  }
  K <- list(bacteria = load_kingdom("bacteria"), fungi = load_kingdom("fungi"))

  ## ---- Table 1: within-soil neighbour effect -------------------------------------
  within <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(K), function(kg) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(SOILS), function(sc) {
    m <- K[[kg]]$meta[K[[kg]]$meta$soil == sc, ]; X <- K[[kg]]$X[rownames(m), ]
    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("all treatments", "weeds only"), function(set) {
      mm <- if (set == "weeds only") m[!m$species %in% CTRL, ] else m
      a <- adonis2(vegdist(X[rownames(mm), ], "bray") ~ species, data = mm, permutations = 999)
      data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[[sc]], set = set, n_pots = nrow(mm), df = a$Df[1],
                 R2_pct = 100 * a$R2[1], F = a$F[1], P = a$`Pr(>F)`[1])
    }))
  }))))
  write.csv(within, file.path(OUT, "table1_within_soil.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  ## ---- Fig. 4: direct microbiota-growth test ---------------------------------------
  direct <- list(); scores <- list(); taxa <- list()
  for (kg in names(K)) for (sc in names(SOILS)) {
    m <- K[[kg]]$meta[K[[kg]]$meta$soil == sc & !is.na(K[[kg]]$meta$Dry_wheat_mass) & !K[[kg]]$meta$species %in% CTRL, ]
    X <- K[[kg]]$X[rownames(m), ]; X <- X / rowSums(X)
    cen <- rowsum(X, m$species) / as.vector(table(m$species)[rownames(rowsum(X, m$species))])
    sp  <- rownames(cen)
    d <- data.frame(species = sp,
                    biomass = tapply(m$Dry_wheat_mass, m$species, mean)[sp],
                    Btot    = tapply(m$Adventice_dry_mass, m$species, mean, na.rm = TRUE)[sp],
                    family  = tapply(m$family, m$species, `[`, 1)[sp])
    d$Monocot <- as.numeric(d$family %in% c("Poaceae", "Juncaceae")); d$Legume <- as.numeric(d$species %in% LEGUMES)
    D <- vegdist(cen, "bray")
    fit <- function(f, dd = d, DD = D) { a <- anova(dbrda(f, data = dd), permutations = how(nperm = NPERM)); c(F = a$F[1], P = a$`Pr(>F)`[1]) }
    m0 <- dbrda(D ~ biomass, data = d); r2 <- RsquareAdj(m0)$r.squared
    u  <- fit(D ~ biomass)
    c1 <- fit(D ~ biomass + Condition(Monocot))
    c2 <- fit(D ~ biomass + Condition(Monocot + Legume))
    okb <- !is.na(d$Btot); Db <- vegdist(cen[okb, ], "bray")
    c3 <- fit(Db ~ biomass + Condition(Btot), d[okb, ], Db)
    nl <- d$Legume == 0; Dn <- vegdist(cen[nl, ], "bray"); c4 <- fit(Dn ~ biomass, d[nl, ], Dn)
    direct[[length(direct) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[[sc]], n_species = nrow(d), R2_pct = 100 * r2,
      F = u["F"], P = u["P"], P_given_monocot = c1["P"], P_given_monocot_legume = c2["P"], P_given_Btot = c3["P"],
      R2_adj_pct = 100 * RsquareAdj(m0)$adj.r.squared,
      R2_without_legumes_pct = 100 * RsquareAdj(dbrda(Dn ~ biomass, data = d[nl, ]))$r.squared,
      P_without_legumes = c4["P"], r_biomass_monocot = cor(d$biomass, d$Monocot))
    ## per-taxon screen at the same unit: Spearman of species-mean relative abundance with species-mean biomass
    elig <- colnames(X)[colMeans(X > 0) >= 0.10 & colMeans(X) >= 1e-4]
    st <- t(sapply(elig, function(a) { ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(cen[, a], d$biomass, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)); c(ct$estimate, ct$p.value) }))
    taxa[[length(taxa) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[[sc]], ASV = elig, rho = st[, 1], P = st[, 2], q_BH = p.adjust(st[, 2], "BH"))
    sc1 <- scores(m0, display = "sites", choices = 1:2, scaling = 1)
    scores[[length(scores) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[[sc]], species = sp, family = d$family,
      biomass = d$biomass, CAP1 = sc1[, 1], MDS1 = sc1[, 2],
      eig_CAP1_pct = 100 * m0$CCA$eig[1] / m0$tot.chi, eig_MDS1_pct = 100 * m0$CA$eig[1] / m0$tot.chi)
  }
  direct <- do.call(rbind, direct); direct$q_BH <- p.adjust(direct$P, "BH")
  taxa <- do.call(rbind, taxa); write.csv(taxa, file.path(OUT, "fig4_taxon_screen.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(direct, file.path(OUT, "fig4_direct_test.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(do.call(rbind, scores), file.path(OUT, "fig4_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  ## ---- Fig. S6: Glomeromycota --------------------------------------------------------
  tax <- read.delim(file.path(DATA, "tax_fungi_R_647ASVs.csv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  glom <- rownames(tax)[grepl("^Glomeromycota", tax$Phylum)]
  m <- K$fungi$meta; X <- K$fungi$X[rownames(m), ]; m$glom <- 100 * rowSums(X[, intersect(glom, colnames(X))]) / rowSums(X)
  w <- wilcox.test(glom ~ soil, data = m)
  spm <- aggregate(glom ~ soil + species + family, data = m[!m$species %in% CTRL, ], FUN = mean)
  fab <- function(s) { x <- if (is.null(s)) spm else spm[spm$soil == s, ]; wilcox.test(x$glom[x$family == "Fabaceae"], x$glom[x$family != "Fabaceae"])$p.value }
  glo <- data.frame(test = c("soil (pots)", "Fabaceae vs other weeds, species means, cereal-dominated", "same, mixed-system", "same, both soils pooled"),
    stat = c(sprintf("mean %.2f vs %.2f %%; median %.2f vs %.2f %% (mixed vs cereal)",
                     mean(m$glom[m$soil == "Permissive"]), mean(m$glom[m$soil == "resistant"]),
                     median(m$glom[m$soil == "Permissive"]), median(m$glom[m$soil == "resistant"])), "", "", ""),
    n = c(nrow(m), sum(spm$soil == "resistant"), sum(spm$soil == "Permissive"), nrow(spm)),
    P = c(w$p.value, fab("resistant"), fab("Permissive"), fab(NULL)))
  write.csv(glo, file.path(OUT, "figS6_glomeromycota_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(OUT, "sessionInfo_revision.txt"))
  message("done")
}
if (!file.exists(file.path(REV_DIR, "fig4_direct_test.csv"))) revision_analyses(MATRIX_DIR, REV_DIR, NPERM = 9999)
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(REV_DIR, "table1_within_soil.csv")), digits = 3)
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(REV_DIR, "figS6_glomeromycota_tests.csv")), digits = 4)
```

### Fig. S4: multivariate dispersion (PERMDISP)

```{r fig-s4-permdisp, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 6.4}
set.seed(20260917)   # permutest() draws permutations: fix them per chunk
## PERMDISP: is a PERMANOVA 'location' effect really a difference in spread
SOIL_COL <- c("Cereal-dominated (AF193)" = "#4C6E9E",   # same palette as Fig. 1 / Fig. S7
              "Mixed-system (AF190)"     = "#C4713A")
permdisp_one <- function(ps, kingdom, factor) {
  meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  D    <- vegan::vegdist(t(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")), method = "bray")
  g    <- if (factor == "soil") factor(SOILNAME[match(meta$soil, SOILS)], levels = SOILNAME)
          else droplevels(factor(meta$species))
  bd   <- vegan::betadisper(D, g, type = "median")
  pt   <- vegan::permutest(bd, permutations = NPERM)
  tab  <- pt$tab
  list(test = data.frame(kingdom = kingdom, factor = factor,
                         df1 = tab$Df[1], df2 = tab$Df[2], F = tab$F[1],
                         p_perm = tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], n = length(g)),
       dist = data.frame(kingdom = kingdom, factor = factor, sample = rownames(meta),
                         group = as.character(g), soil = SOILNAME[match(meta$soil, SOILS)],
                         distance = as.numeric(bd$distances)))
}
pd_res <- list(); k <- 0
for (kg in c("bacteria", "fungi")) {
  ps <- if (kg == "bacteria") physeq_bacteria else physeq_fungi
  for (fc in c("soil", "species")) { k <- k + 1; pd_res[[k]] <- permdisp_one(ps, kg, fc) }
}
permdisp_tests <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pd_res, `[[`, "test"))
permdisp_dist  <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pd_res, `[[`, "dist"))
write.csv(permdisp_tests, file.path(OUT_DIR, "permdisp_tests.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(permdisp_dist,  file.path(OUT_DIR, "permdisp_distances.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(permdisp_tests, digits = 3)

lab_test <- function(kg, fc) {
  r <- permdisp_tests[permdisp_tests$kingdom == kg & permdisp_tests$factor == fc, ]
  sprintf("F[%d,%d] = %.2f, p = %.2f", r$df1, r$df2, r$F, r$p_perm)
}
KLAB <- c(bacteria = "Bacteria (rpoB)", fungi = "Fungi (ITS)")
pan_soil <- function(kg) {
  d <- permdisp_dist[permdisp_dist$kingdom == kg & permdisp_dist$factor == "soil", ]
  ggplot(d, aes(group, distance, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.55, colour = "grey25") +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = group), width = 0.12, size = 0.7, alpha = 0.45) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = SOIL_COL, guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = SOIL_COL, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub(" \\(", "\n(", x)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Distance to spatial median\n(Bray-Curtis PCoA)",
         title = KLAB[[kg]], subtitle = paste("Soil:", lab_test(kg, "soil"))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
}
pan_species <- function(kg) {
  d <- permdisp_dist[permdisp_dist$kingdom == kg & permdisp_dist$factor == "species", ]
  ord <- d %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(m = median(distance)) %>% arrange(m) %>% pull(group)
  d$group <- factor(d$group, levels = ord)
  ggplot(d, aes(group, distance)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey88", colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = soil), width = 0.15, size = 0.55, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = SOIL_COL, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Distance to spatial median",
         subtitle = paste("Neighbour species:", lab_test(kg, "species"))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, hjust = 1, face = "italic", size = 6),
          legend.position = "top")
}
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
```

```{r fig-s5-alpha}
alpha_of <- function(ps, label) {
  d <- data.frame(sample = sample_names(ps),
                  richness = phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps, measures = "Observed")[,1],
                  shannon  = phyloseq::estimate_richness(ps, measures = "Shannon")[,1])
  md <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps)); d <- cbind(d, md[, c("soil", "species")])
  d$kingdom <- label
  d
}
alpha_b <- alpha_of(physeq_bacteria, "Bacteria (rpoB)")
alpha_f <- alpha_of(physeq_fungi,    "Fungi (ITS1)")
write.csv(rbind(alpha_b, alpha_f), file.path(OUT_DIR, "alpha_diversity.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

## omega-squared 
omega2_table <- function(d, resp = "richness") {
  m <- aov(as.formula(paste(resp, "~ soil * species")), data = d)
  a <- summary(m)[[1]]
  msr <- a["Residuals", "Mean Sq"]; sst <- sum(a[, "Sum Sq"])
  data.frame(term = trimws(rownames(a)), df = a[, "Df"], F = a[, "F value"],
             p = a[, "Pr(>F)"],
             omega2 = (a[, "Sum Sq"] - a[, "Df"] * msr) / (sst + msr))
}
for (d in list(alpha_b, alpha_f)) {
  cat("\n--", d$kingdom[1], "-- observed richness\n")
  print(omega2_table(d, "richness"), row.names = FALSE, digits = 3)
}
```

### Fig. S7: βNTI and NST, bacteria (Methods S2)
```{r nst-generate}
NST_GEN   <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "NST")
RUN_NST   <- identical(Sys.getenv("PAPER_RUN_NST", "false"), "true")
RUN_BNTI  <- identical(Sys.getenv("PAPER_RUN_BNTI", "false"), "true")
NST_RAND  <- 1000
BNTI_RAND <- 999
NST_SEED  <- 20261104

nst_groups <- function(ps, min_pots = 3) {
  M <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix"); if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) M <- t(M)
  M <- M[, colSums(M > 0) >= 2, drop = FALSE]
  md <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")[rownames(M), ]
  g <- paste(md$soil, md$species, sep = ".")
  out <- lapply(split(rownames(M), g), function(ids) {
    m <- M[ids, , drop = FALSE]; m[rowSums(m) > 0, colSums(m) > 0, drop = FALSE]
  })
  out[vapply(out, function(m) nrow(m) >= min_pots && ncol(m) >= 2, logical(1))]
}
split_group <- function(d) {
  d$Soil <- sub("\\..*$", "", d$Group); d$Species <- sub("^[^.]*\\.", "", d$Group)
  d[, c("Group", "Soil", "Species", setdiff(names(d), c("Group", "Soil", "Species")))]
}
one_group <- function(m, nm) data.frame(group = rep(nm, nrow(m)), row.names = rownames(m))

run_tNST <- function(ps) {
  set.seed(NST_SEED)
  G <- nst_groups(ps)
  split_group(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(G), function(g) {
    r <- NST::tNST(comm = G[[g]], group = one_group(G[[g]], g), dist.method = "bray", abundance.weighted = TRUE,
                   rand = NST_RAND, output.rand = FALSE, nworker = 1)$index.grp
    data.frame(Group = g, NST = r$NST.i.bray[1], N_sto = r$ST.i.bray[1], N_det = r$MST.i.bray[1], n_pots = nrow(G[[g]]))
  })))
}

run_pNST <- function(ps, tree_file) {
  set.seed(NST_SEED)
  tr <- ape::read.tree(tree_file)
  keep <- intersect(taxa_names(ps), tr$tip.label)
  stopifnot(length(keep) == ntaxa(ps))                      # every ASV is a tip of the deposited tree
  PD <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(ape::keep.tip(tr, keep))
  G <- nst_groups(ps)
  split_group(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(G), function(g) {
    m <- G[[g]]
    r <- NST::pNST(comm = m, pd = PD[colnames(m), colnames(m)], group = one_group(m, g), abundance.weighted = TRUE,
                   rand = NST_RAND, output.rand = FALSE, nworker = 1)$index.grp[1, ]
    col <- function(p) as.numeric(r[[grep(p, names(r))[1]]])
    data.frame(Group = g, pNST = col("^NST\\.i"), pN_sto = col("^ST\\.i"), pN_det = col("^MST\\.i"), n_pots = nrow(m))
  })))
}

run_bNTI <- function(ps, tree_file) {                       # mean betaNTI per group, as in Methods S2
  set.seed(NST_SEED)
  tr <- ape::read.tree(tree_file)
  G <- nst_groups(ps, min_pots = 2)
  split_group(do.call(rbind, lapply(names(G), function(g) {
    m <- G[[g]]; sub <- ape::keep.tip(tr, colnames(m))
    obs <- as.matrix(picante::comdistnt(m, ape::cophenetic.phylo(sub), abundance.weighted = TRUE))
    null <- replicate(BNTI_RAND, {
      s <- sub; s$tip.label <- sample(s$tip.label)
      as.matrix(picante::comdistnt(m, ape::cophenetic.phylo(s), abundance.weighted = TRUE))
    })
    sdv <- apply(null, 1:2, sd); sdv[!is.finite(sdv) | sdv == 0] <- 1e-9
    b <- ((obs - apply(null, 1:2, mean)) / sdv)[upper.tri(obs)]; b <- b[is.finite(b)]
    data.frame(Group = g, pairs = length(b), mean_bNTI = mean(b), frac_var_sel = mean(b > 2),
               frac_hom_sel = mean(b < -2), frac_stoch = mean(abs(b) <= 2))
  })))
}

if (RUN_NST) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("NST", quietly = TRUE))
  dir.create(NST_GEN, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  write.csv(run_tNST(physeq_bacteria), file.path(NST_GEN, "NST_bacteria.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(run_tNST(physeq_fungi),    file.path(NST_GEN, "NST_fungi.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(run_pNST(physeq_bacteria, TREE_BACT), file.path(NST_GEN, "pNST_bacteria.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(run_pNST(physeq_fungi,    TREE_FUNG), file.path(NST_GEN, "pnst_fungi.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
  if (RUN_BNTI) {
    stopifnot(requireNamespace("picante", quietly = TRUE))
    write.csv(run_bNTI(physeq_bacteria, TREE_BACT), file.path(NST_GEN, "bnti_bacteria.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  } else if (file.exists(file.path(NST_DIR, "bnti_bacteria.csv"))) file.copy(file.path(NST_DIR, "bnti_bacteria.csv"), NST_GEN, overwrite = TRUE)
  else stop("bnti_bacteria.csv is not deposited here: set PAPER_RUN_BNTI = \"true\"")   # [INT 12]
  cat(sprintf("NST tables written to %s (%.0f min)\n", NST_GEN, as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
}
if (RUN_NST) NST_DIR <- NST_GEN                              # the tables just written are the ones used below
cat("NST tables used:", NST_DIR, "\n")
```

### Methods S2: turnover partition and the independent βNTI check

```{r assembly-check}
## iCAMP (bNTIn.p), compared with the picante values of Fig. S7a. 
## Turnover (betapart) and bacterial βNTI (iCAMP::bNTIn.p, from the NST authors) for Methods S2 / Fig. S7.
## Turnover runs anywhere betapart is installed; βNTI needs iCAMP (install.packages("iCAMP")) and the rpoB ASV tree.
assembly_check <- function(DF, TREE, OUT, RAND = 999, NW = 4) {
  dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE); set.seed(20261103)
  SOIL <- c(resistant = "Cereal-dominated (AF193)", Permissive = "Mixed-system (AF190)")
  load_k <- function(k, n) {
    X <- t(as.matrix(read.delim(file.path(DF, sprintf("otu_%s_table_R_%dASVs.csv", k, n)), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)))
    m <- read.csv(file.path(DF, sprintf("metadata_%s_%dASVs.csv", k, n))); rownames(m) <- m$sample
    m <- m[intersect(rownames(X), rownames(m)), ]; list(X = X[rownames(m), ], m = m)
  }
  ## ---- 1. turnover share of Sorensen dissimilarity (betapart::beta.pair), per kingdom x soil
  tv <- list()
  for (kk in list(c("bacteria", 1314), c("fungi", 647))) {
    d <- load_k(kk[1], as.integer(kk[2]))
    for (s in names(SOIL)) {
      PA <- (d$X[d$m$soil == s, ] > 0) * 1; PA <- PA[, colSums(PA) > 0]
      bp <- betapart::beta.pair(PA, index.family = "sorensen")
      sim <- as.vector(bp$beta.sim); sor <- as.vector(bp$beta.sor)
      tv[[length(tv) + 1]] <- data.frame(kingdom = kk[1], soil = SOIL[[s]], pots = nrow(PA), mean_beta_sor = mean(sor), mean_beta_sim = mean(sim),
                                         mean_beta_sne = mean(as.vector(bp$beta.sne)), turnover_share_pct = 100 * mean(sim) / mean(sor),
                                         turnover_share_pairwise_pct = 100 * mean((sim / sor)[sor > 0]))
    }
  }
  tv <- do.call(rbind, tv); write.csv(tv, file.path(OUT, "turnover_betapart.csv"), row.names = FALSE); print(tv, digits = 4)
  ## ---- 2. bacterial βNTI per neighbour x soil group (iCAMP::bNTIn.p, abundance-weighted βMNTD, taxa shuffled across tips)
  if (requireNamespace("iCAMP", quietly = TRUE) && file.exists(TREE)) {
    tr <- ape::read.tree(TREE); d <- load_k("bacteria", 1314); keep <- intersect(colnames(d$X), tr$tip.label)
    tr <- ape::keep.tip(tr, keep); pd <- cophenetic(tr); rows <- list()
    for (s in names(SOIL)) for (g in sort(unique(d$m$species[d$m$soil == s]))) {
      idx <- rownames(d$m)[d$m$soil == s & d$m$species == g]; if (length(idx) < 3) next
      cm <- d$X[idx, keep]; cm <- cm[, colSums(cm) > 0, drop = FALSE]
      b <- iCAMP::bNTIn.p(comm = cm, dis = pd[colnames(cm), colnames(cm)], nworker = NW, weighted = TRUE, rand = RAND)
      v <- as.matrix(b$index); v <- v[upper.tri(v)]
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(soil = SOIL[[s]], species = g, pots = length(idx), mean_bNTI = mean(v), sd_bNTI = sd(v),
                                             pct_pairs_above2 = 100 * mean(v > 2), pct_pairs_below_minus2 = 100 * mean(v < -2))
      cat(s, g, round(mean(v), 2), "\n")
    }
    bn <- do.call(rbind, rows); write.csv(bn, file.path(OUT, "bNTI_bacteria_iCAMP.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    cat("groups with mean bNTI > 2:", sum(bn$mean_bNTI > 2), "of", nrow(bn), "\n")
  } else message("iCAMP or tree not available: bNTI skipped")
}

ASM_DIR <- file.path(SUPP_DIR, "assembly_check")
if (identical(Sys.getenv("PAPER_RUN_ASSEMBLY", "false"), "true")) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("betapart", quietly = TRUE))
  assembly_check(MATRIX_DIR, TREE_BACT, ASM_DIR, RAND = 999, NW = 4)
}
if (file.exists(file.path(ASM_DIR, "turnover_betapart.csv")))
  print(knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(ASM_DIR, "turnover_betapart.csv")), digits = 3))
f_icamp <- file.path(ASM_DIR, "bNTI_bacteria_iCAMP.csv")
if (file.exists(f_icamp)) {   # agreement with the picante betaNTI of Fig. S7a
  ic <- read.csv(f_icamp); pc <- read.csv(file.path(NST_DIR, "bnti_bacteria.csv"))
  sp <- gsub("_", " ", pc$Species); hit <- sp %in% names(SYNONYMS); sp[hit] <- SYNONYMS[sp[hit]]
  norm <- function(x) gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(x))
  pc$key <- paste(pc$Soil, norm(sp))
  ic$key <- paste(ifelse(grepl("Cereal", ic$soil), SOILS[["cereal"]], SOILS[["mixed"]]), norm(ic$species))
  mm <- merge(ic, pc, by = "key")
  cat(sprintf("iCAMP vs picante mean betaNTI: %d groups, r = %.3f, mean |diff| = %.3f\n", nrow(mm),
              cor(mm$mean_bNTI.x, mm$mean_bNTI.y), mean(abs(mm$mean_bNTI.x - mm$mean_bNTI.y))))
}
```

## 3.1.2 Neighbour-enriched taxa

```{r da-export}
da_summary <- function(root, methods = c("DESeq2", "edgeR", "metagenomeSeq")) {
  pat <- c(DESeq2 = "DESeq_%s_%s_species_vs_wheat_x_wheat_pval.csv", edgeR = "edgeR_%s_%s_vs_wheat_x_wheat.csv",
           metagenomeSeq = "MetaSeq_%s_%s_CSS_wheat_x_wheat.csv")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(methods, function(m) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("bacteria", "fungi"), function(kg)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Resistant", "Permissive"), function(tag) {
      f <- file.path(root, paste0(m, "_species"), sprintf(pat[[m]], kg, tag))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      d <- read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE)
      if (m == "metagenomeSeq") {
        d <- d[!is.na(d[["NA"]]), ]; q <- d$adjPvalues; enr <- d[["NA"]] > 2
        nb <- sub("\\.Cluster_[0-9]+$", "", d[[1]]); asv <- sub("^.*\\.(Cluster_[0-9]+)$", "\\1", d[[1]])
      } else {
        q <- if (m == "DESeq2") d$padj else d$FDR; lfc <- if (m == "DESeq2") d$log2FoldChange else d$logFC
        enr <- lfc < -2; nb <- d$comparison; asv <- d$taxa
      }
      s <- which(q < 0.05 & enr)
      data.frame(method = m, kingdom = kg, soil = tag, rows = nrow(d), neighbours = length(unique(nb)),
                 adjP_0.05 = sum(q < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), adjP_0.05_enriched_lfc2 = length(s),
                 ASVs_enriched = length(unique(asv[s])))
    }))))))
}


da_export <- function(MATRIX_DIR, OUT, KINGDOMS = c("bacteria", "fungi"), SOILS = c("Resistant", "Permissive")) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE), requireNamespace("metagenomeSeq", quietly = TRUE))
  SOIL_CODE <- c(Resistant = "resistant", Permissive = "Permissive")   # metadata 
  TABLES <- list(bacteria = c("otu_bacteria_table_R_1314ASVs.csv", "tax_bacteria_R_1314ASVs.csv", "metadata_bacteria_1314ASVs.csv"),
                 fungi    = c("otu_fungi_table_R_647ASVs.csv",     "tax_fungi_R_647ASVs.csv",     "metadata_fungi_647ASVs.csv"))
  CONTROL <- "wheat x wheat"
  for (d in c("DESeq2_species", "metagenomeSeq_species")) dir.create(file.path(OUT, d), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  build <- function(kg) {
    f <- TABLES[[kg]]
    otu  <- read.delim(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, f[1]), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
    tax  <- read.delim(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, f[2]), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
    meta <- read.csv(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, f[3]), check.names = FALSE)
    rownames(meta) <- meta$sample; keep <- intersect(colnames(otu), rownames(meta))
    phyloseq(otu_table(as.matrix(otu[, keep]), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
             tax_table(as.matrix(tax[rownames(otu), , drop = FALSE])),
             sample_data(meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]))
  }

  deseq_one <- function(ps) {
    md <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame"); md$species <- factor(md$species)
    sample_data(ps)$species <- md$species
    dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps, ~ species)
    dds <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds, type = "poscounts")
    dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric", quiet = TRUE)
    out <- data.frame()
    for (sp in setdiff(levels(md$species), CONTROL)) {
      res <- DESeq2::results(dds, contrast = c("species", CONTROL, sp))
      sig <- res[which(res$pvalue < 0.05), ]
      if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
        sig <- as.data.frame(sig); sig$taxa <- rownames(sig); sig$comparison <- paste(CONTROL, "vs", sp)
        out <- rbind(out, sig)
      }
    }
    out
  }

  mgs_one <- function(ps) {
    sample_data(ps)$species <- as.factor(sample_data(ps)$species)
    psf <- filter_taxa(ps, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 5, TRUE)
    mr  <- phyloseq_to_metagenomeSeq(psf)
    mr  <- metagenomeSeq::cumNorm(mr)
    mr  <- metagenomeSeq::filterData(mr, present = 0.05, depth = 5)
    nc  <- metagenomeSeq::MRcounts(mr, norm = TRUE)
    md  <- data.frame(sample_data(psf))[colnames(nc), ]
    md$species <- relevel(as.factor(md$species), ref = CONTROL)
    mod <- model.matrix(~ species, data = md)
    fit <- metagenomeSeq::fitZig(obj = mr, mod = mod, useCSSoffset = TRUE, control = metagenomeSeq::zigControl(maxit = 50, verbose = FALSE))
    res <- list()
    for (sp in setdiff(levels(md$species), CONTROL)) {
      r <- metagenomeSeq::MRcoefs(fit, coef = paste0("species", sp), adjustMethod = "bonferroni", alpha = 0.05, number = nrow(nc))
      res[[sp]] <- r[which(r$adjPvalues < 0.05), ]  
    }
    do.call(rbind, res)
  }

  for (kg in KINGDOMS) {
    ps_all <- build(kg)
    for (s in SOILS) {
      ps <- prune_samples(sample_data(ps_all)$soil == SOIL_CODE[[s]], ps_all)
      t0 <- Sys.time()
      d <- deseq_one(ps)
      write.csv(d, file.path(OUT, "DESeq2_species", sprintf("DESeq_%s_%s_species_vs_wheat_x_wheat_pval.csv", kg, s)), row.names = TRUE)
      m <- mgs_one(ps)
      write.csv(m, file.path(OUT, "metagenomeSeq_species", sprintf("MetaSeq_%s_%s_CSS_wheat_x_wheat.csv", kg, s)), row.names = TRUE)
      cat(sprintf("%s %s: %d samples | DESeq2 %d rows | metagenomeSeq %d rows | %.1f min\n", kg, s, nsamples(ps),
                  nrow(d), nrow(m), as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r da-orientation}
set.seed(20260917)
orient_one <- function(ps, f, method, soil_code) {
  d <- read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE)
  X <- t(as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")); X <- X / rowSums(X) * 7000
  meta <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  ctrl <- rownames(meta)[meta$soil == soil_code & meta$species == "wheat x wheat"]
  raw <- function(w) {
    a <- rownames(meta)[meta$soil == soil_code & meta$species == w]
    if (!length(a)) return(NULL)
    log2((colMeans(X[a, , drop = FALSE]) + 0.5) / (colMeans(X[ctrl, , drop = FALSE]) + 0.5))
  }
  if (method == "metagenomeSeq") {
    k <- as.character(d[[1]])
    d$weed <- gsub(".", " ", sub("\\.Cluster_[0-9]+$", "", k), fixed = TRUE)
    d$taxa <- sub("^.*\\.(Cluster_[0-9]+)$", "\\1", k); d$lfc <- d[["NA"]]
    d <- d[!is.na(d$lfc), ]   #
  } else {
    d <- split_comparison(d)
    d <- d[d$species1 == "wheat x wheat" | d$species2 == "wheat x wheat", ]
    if (!nrow(d)) return(data.frame(file = basename(f), n_neighbours = 0, median_r = NA,
                                    ids_in_table = NA, verdict = "control absent"))
    d$weed <- ifelse(d$species1 == "wheat x wheat", d$species2, d$species1)
    d$lfc  <- if (method == "DESeq2") d$log2FoldChange else d$logFC
  }
  d$weed[d$weed %in% names(SYNONYMS)] <- SYNONYMS[d$weed[d$weed %in% names(SYNONYMS)]]
  r <- sapply(split(d, d$weed), function(g) {
    rr <- raw(g$weed[1]); if (is.null(rr)) return(NA)
    ok <- g$taxa %in% names(rr); if (sum(ok) < 10) return(NA)
    suppressWarnings(cor(g$lfc[ok], rr[g$taxa[ok]]))
  })
  m <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(file = basename(f), n_neighbours = sum(!is.na(r)), median_r = round(m, 2),
             ids_in_table = round(mean(unique(d$taxa) %in% taxa_names(ps)), 2),
             verdict = if (is.na(m) || abs(m) < 0.5) "REFUSE: other numbering or mislabelled"
                       else if (m > 0) "log2(neighbour / control)" else "log2(control / neighbour)")
}
## "log2(control / neighbour)" (DESeq2, edgeR) or "log2(neighbour / control)" (metagenomeSeq).
DA_TEST <- unique(c(used = DA_ROOT, regenerated = DA_REGEN))
ps_of <- list(bacteria = physeq_bacteria, fungi = physeq_fungi)
orient <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ps_of), function(kg) do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Resistant", "Permissive"), function(tag) {
  code <- if (tag == "Resistant") SOILS[["cereal"]] else SOILS[["mixed"]]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(DA_TEST, function(root) {
    fs <- c(DESeq2 = file.path(root, "DESeq2_species", sprintf("DESeq_%s_%s_species_vs_wheat_x_wheat_pval.csv", kg, tag)),
            edgeR  = file.path(root, "edgeR_species",  sprintf("edgeR_%s_%s_vs_wheat_x_wheat.csv", kg, tag)),
            metagenomeSeq = file.path(root, "metagenomeSeq_species", sprintf("MetaSeq_%s_%s_CSS_wheat_x_wheat.csv", kg, tag)))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fs), function(m) if (file.exists(fs[[m]]))
      cbind(kingdom = kg, soil = tag, root = if (root == DA_ROOT) "used" else "regenerated", method = m,
            orient_one(ps_of[[kg]], fs[[m]], m, code))))
  }))
}))))
write.csv(orient, file.path(OUT_DIR, "check_da_orientation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
stopifnot(!any(grepl("REFUSE", orient$verdict[orient$root == "used"])))
```

```{r da-compare}
da_rows <- function(f, m) {

  } else {
    d$weed <- sub("^wheat[ .]x[ .]wheat vs ", "", d$comparison)

  }

  d$weed[d$weed %in% names(SYNONYMS)] <- SYNONYMS[d$weed[d$weed %in% names(SYNONYMS)]]
```

## 3.2.1 Wheat biomass

### Table S5: wheat biomass with total neighbour biomass (Fig. 3, Table S4 and the log-scale model: notebook 3.2.1)

```{r table-s5-biomass}
bio <- metadata_bacteria[!is.na(metadata_bacteria[[RESP]]), ]
m_bio <- aov(as.formula(paste(RESP, "~ soil * species")), data = bio)
print(summary(m_bio))

## Table S5: does total neighbour biomass (Btot) explain wheat biomass beyond neighbour identity? 
## effect for the other and for Btot. partial eta^2 = SS_Btot / (SS_Btot + SS_res).
stopifnot(requireNamespace("car", quietly = TRUE))   # Type II sums of squares
bio_w <- metadata_bacteria[!is.na(metadata_bacteria[[RESP]]) &
                         !is.na(metadata_bacteria$Adventice_dry_mass) &
                         !metadata_bacteria$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), ]
bio_w$species <- droplevels(factor(bio_w$species))
m_base <- lm(as.formula(paste0("log(", RESP, ") ~ soil * species")), data = bio_w)   # log scale, as the main model
m_cov  <- lm(as.formula(paste0("log(", RESP, ") ~ soil * species + Adventice_dry_mass")), data = bio_w)
s6 <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(m_cov, type = 2))
s6$partial_eta2 <- s6$`Sum Sq` / (s6$`Sum Sq` + s6["Residuals", "Sum Sq"])
s6["Residuals", "partial_eta2"] <- NA
attr(s6, "R2") <- c(base = summary(m_base)$r.squared, with_Btot = summary(m_cov)$r.squared)
write.csv(cbind(term = rownames(s6), s6), file.path(OUT_DIR, "Table_S6_biomass_ancova.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(s6, digits = 4)
cat(sprintf("n pots = %d, neighbour species = %d, R2 %.3f -> %.3f, Btot slope %.4f (SE %.4f)\n",
            nrow(bio_w), nlevels(bio_w$species), summary(m_base)$r.squared, summary(m_cov)$r.squared,
            coef(m_cov)[["Adventice_dry_mass"]], sqrt(diag(vcov(m_cov)))[["Adventice_dry_mass"]]))
write.csv(data.frame(model = c("soil * species", "soil * species + Btot"),
                     R2 = c(summary(m_base)$r.squared, summary(m_cov)$r.squared),
                     n = nrow(bio_w)), file.path(OUT_DIR, "Table_S6_model_R2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### TITAN2 (Methods 2.8, Methods S3)

```{r titan-export}
#| cache: false   
## ===========================================================================
## TITAN2 along the pot-level wheat-biomass gradient, per kingdom and soil
## (Methods 2.8, Methods S3, Table S7).
##
## raw (rarefied) counts; titan(minSplt = 5, nBoot = 500, numPerm = 250 (default),
## pur.cut = rel.cut = 0.95, imax = FALSE, ivTot = FALSE). 
##
## ===========================================================================
titan_export <- function(MATRIX_DIR, OUT, TAXA_FROM = NA, NBOOT = 500,
                         CELLS = c("bacteria_soilA", "bacteria_soilB", "fungi_soilA", "fungi_soilB"), NCPUS = 1) {
  SEED       <- 20261104
  SOIL_CODE  <- c(soilA = "resistant", soilB = "Permissive")   # cereal-dominated, mixed-system
  TABLES     <- list(bacteria = c("otu_bacteria_table_R_1314ASVs.csv", "metadata_bacteria_1314ASVs.csv"),
                     fungi    = c("otu_fungi_table_R_647ASVs.csv",     "metadata_fungi_647ASVs.csv"))
  dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  for (cell in CELLS) {
    kg <- sub("_.*", "", cell); key <- sub(".*_", "", cell)
    otu  <- read.delim(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, TABLES[[kg]][1]), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)   # ASVs x samples
    meta <- read.csv(file.path(MATRIX_DIR, TABLES[[kg]][2]), check.names = FALSE)
    meta <- meta[meta$sample %in% colnames(otu) & meta$soil == SOIL_CODE[[key]] & !is.na(meta$Dry_wheat_mass), ]
    X <- t(as.matrix(otu[, meta$sample]))                                                         # samples x ASVs
    X <- X[, colSums(X > 0) >= 10, drop = FALSE]
    if (!is.na(TAXA_FROM)) {
      prev <- read.csv(file.path(TAXA_FROM, sprintf("%s_titan_%s_results_v3.csv", kg, key)), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
      stopifnot(all(rownames(prev) %in% colnames(X)))
      X <- X[, rownames(prev), drop = FALSE]
    }
    set.seed(SEED)
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    res <- TITAN2::titan(env = as.numeric(meta$Dry_wheat_mass), txa = as.data.frame(X), minSplt = 5, nBoot = NBOOT, boot = TRUE,
                 pur.cut = 0.95, rel.cut = 0.95, imax = FALSE, ivTot = FALSE, ncpus = NCPUS, messaging = FALSE)
    sp <- res$sppmax
    write.csv(sp, file.path(OUT, sprintf("%s_titan_%s_results_v3.csv", kg, key)), row.names = TRUE)
    ok <- sp[, "purity"] >= 0.95 & sp[, "reliability"] >= 0.95
    cat(sprintf("%s %s: %d pots, %d ASVs tested, %d pure and reliable (z- %d, z+ %d), %.1f min\n", kg, key, nrow(X), ncol(X),
                sum(ok), sum(ok & sp[, "maxgrp"] == 1), sum(ok & sp[, "maxgrp"] == 2),
                as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
  }
}

## deposited exports (the input of the original runs). PAPER_TITAN = "regenerated" makes them the files read below.
```

# 3.3 Weed traits and phylogeny

### Table 2, Notes S3: single-trait db-RDA, joint model and Mantel test

```{r table-2}
## =============================================================================
## trait_models_v3.R  --  Table 2, Notes S3 (traits) and the Mantel test
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
##   tree_file : weeds + wheat tree (V.PhyloMaker2, GBOTB.extended.WP, scenario S3),  weeds_wheat_VPM2_WP_S3.tre
##
## Per kingdom x soil (weed pots only; the controls carry no weed traits):
##   1. Composition: one db-RDA per species-level trait on Bray-Curtis
##   2. Joint model of the seven traits
##   3. Richness: species means of log richness on the standardised traits (one model per cell).
##   4. Mantel test: weed x weed cophenetic distance vs species-centroid Bray-Curtis (9,999 perm.).
##   5. VIF of the traits at species level.
## =============================================================================

trait_models <- function(DATA, TRAITF, TREEF, OUT, NPERM = 999, CORES = 4) {
  dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  set.seed(20261016)

  SOILS <- c(resistant = "Cereal-dominated (AF193)", Permissive = "Mixed-system (AF190)")
  JOINT  <- c("Distance", "Segetal", "Nitrogen", "Light", "SRL", "RDMC", "RootShoot")
  TRAITS <- c(JOINT, "Monocot")

  ## ---- 1. phylogeny ------------------------------------------------------------
  tr <- read.csv(TRAITF, check.names = FALSE)
  meta0 <- read.csv(file.path(DATA, "metadata_bacteria_1314ASVs.csv"))
  fam <- unique(meta0[!meta0$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), c("species", "family")])
  splist <- rbind(data.frame(species = fam$species, genus = sub(" .*", "", fam$species), family = fam$family),
                  data.frame(species = "Triticum aestivum", genus = "Triticum", family = "Poaceae"))
  if (requireNamespace("V.PhyloMaker2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    phy <- V.PhyloMaker2::phylo.maker(splist, tree = V.PhyloMaker2::GBOTB.extended.WP,
                                      nodes = V.PhyloMaker2::nodes.info.1.WP, scenarios = "S3")$scenario.3
    ape::write.tree(phy, file.path(OUT, "weeds_wheat_VPM2_WP_S3.tre"))
  } else phy <- ape::read.tree(TREEF)
  coph <- cophenetic(phy); rownames(coph) <- colnames(coph) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(coph))
  tr$Distance <- coph[tr$species, "Triticum aestivum"]
  tr$Monocot  <- as.numeric(tr$Distance < 250)          # Poaceae and Juncus (<= 188 Myr) vs eudicots (271.5 Myr)
  dist_check <- data.frame(species = tr$species, published = tr$phy_dist_old, recomputed = tr$Distance,
                           changed = abs(tr$phy_dist_old - tr$Distance) > 1e-3)
  write.csv(dist_check, file.path(OUT, "check_phylogenetic_distance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Distance changed for: ", paste(dist_check$species[dist_check$changed], collapse = ", "))

  ## ---- helpers: db-RDA by linear algebra (identical F to vegan::dbrda) ----------
  gower_lingoes <- function(D) {
    D <- as.matrix(D); n <- nrow(D); J <- diag(n) - 1 / n
    G <- J %*% (-0.5 * D^2) %*% J
    ev <- eigen(G, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
    if (min(ev) < -1e-10 * max(abs(ev))) {               # Lingoes (dbrda add = TRUE)
      D2 <- sqrt(D^2 + 2 * (-min(ev))); diag(D2) <- 0
      G <- J %*% (-0.5 * D2^2) %*% J
    }
    G
  }
  ssq <- function(X, G) { Q <- qr.Q(qr(cbind(1, X))); sum(Q * (G %*% Q)) }   # trace(H G)
  pseudoF <- function(x, G) {
    n <- nrow(G); s <- ssq(x, G); tot <- sum(diag(G)); p <- NCOL(x)
    c(F = (s / p) / ((tot - s) / (n - p - 1)), R2 = s / tot)
  }

  ## ---- per cell ------------------------------------------------------------------
  run_cell <- function(kg, soil) {
    tag  <- if (kg == "bacteria") "1314" else "647"
    otu  <- read.delim(file.path(DATA, sprintf("otu_%s_table_R_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag)), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
    meta <- read.csv(file.path(DATA, sprintf("metadata_%s_%sASVs.csv", kg, tag)))
    rownames(meta) <- meta$sample
    X <- t(as.matrix(otu)); meta <- meta[intersect(rownames(X), rownames(meta)), ]
    m <- meta[meta$soil == soil & !meta$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), ]
    X <- X[rownames(m), , drop = FALSE]
    T <- tr[match(m$species, tr$species), ]
    dat <- data.frame(species = m$species, Btot = m$Adventice_dry_mass,
                      Distance = T$Distance, Segetal = T$Segetal, Nitrogen = T$EllenN, Light = T$EllenL,
                      SRL = T$SRL, RDMC = T$RDMC, RootShoot = T$RootShoot, Monocot = T$Monocot,
                      rich = rowSums(X > 0), row.names = rownames(m))
    ## composition, one trait at a time
    comp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(TRAITS, function(v) {
      ok <- !is.na(dat[[v]]); d <- dat[ok, ]; G <- gower_lingoes(vegdist(X[ok, ], "bray"))
      obs <- pseudoF(d[[v]], G)
      ## pot-level permutation
      Fpot <- vapply(seq_len(NPERM), function(i) pseudoF(sample(d[[v]]), G)["F"], 0)
      ## species-level permutation
      spv <- tapply(d[[v]], d$species, `[`, 1); sps <- names(spv)
      Fsp <- vapply(seq_len(NPERM), function(i) {
        perm <- setNames(sample(spv), sps); pseudoF(perm[d$species], G)["F"] }, 0)
      Psp <- (sum(Fsp >= obs["F"]) + 1) / (NPERM + 1); nsp <- length(sps)
      data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[soil], trait = v, n_pots = nrow(d), n_species = nsp,
                 F = obs["F"], R2 = obs["R2"], P_pot = (sum(Fpot >= obs["F"]) + 1) / (NPERM + 1), P_species = Psp)
    }))
    ## joint model of the seven traits; null = whole trait profiles reassigned among species
    cc <- complete.cases(dat[, JOINT]); dj <- dat[cc, ]; Gj <- gower_lingoes(vegdist(X[cc, ], "bray"))
    Z  <- scale(dj[, JOINT]); joint <- pseudoF(Z, Gj)
    prof <- unique(cbind(species = dj$species, as.data.frame(Z))); rownames(prof) <- prof$species
    R2null <- vapply(seq_len(NPERM), function(i) {
      s <- setNames(sample(prof$species), prof$species)
      pseudoF(as.matrix(prof[s[dj$species], JOINT]), Gj)["R2"] }, 0)
    R2sp <- pseudoF(model.matrix(~ factor(dj$species))[, -1], Gj)["R2"]
    jt <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[soil], n_pots = sum(cc), n_species = length(unique(dj$species)),
                     R2_total = joint["R2"], F_total = joint["F"], R2_null_mean = mean(R2null),
                     P_species = (sum(R2null >= joint["R2"]) + 1) / (NPERM + 1), R2_species = R2sp,
                     expected_share = length(JOINT) / (length(unique(dj$species)) - 1))
    ## vegan cross-check of one F value 
    ok <- !is.na(dat$Distance)
    vf <- anova(dbrda(vegdist(X[ok, ], "bray") ~ Distance, data = dat[ok, ], add = TRUE), permutations = 0)$F[1]
    stopifnot(abs(vf - comp$F[comp$trait == "Distance"]) < 1e-6)
    ## richness on species means 
    spm <- aggregate(dat[, c("rich", JOINT)], by = list(species = dat$species), FUN = mean)
    spm <- spm[complete.cases(spm), ]; spm$lr <- log(spm$rich); spm[, JOINT] <- scale(spm[, JOINT])
    sfit <- summary(lm(as.formula(paste("lr ~", paste(JOINT, collapse = " + "))), data = spm))$coefficients
    rich <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[soil], trait = JOINT, n_species = nrow(spm),
                       coef_std = sfit[JOINT, 1], P = sfit[JOINT, 4])
    ## Mantel: weed x weed phylogeny vs centroid dissimilarity
    cen <- rowsum(X / rowSums(X), m$species); cen <- cen / as.vector(table(m$species)[rownames(cen)])
    sp <- rownames(cen); Dm <- vegdist(cen, "bray"); Dp <- as.dist(coph[sp, sp])
    mt <- mantel(Dm, Dp, permutations = 9999)
    mant <- data.frame(kingdom = kg, soil = SOILS[soil], n_species = length(sp), mantel_r = mt$statistic, P = mt$signif)
    list(comp = comp, joint = jt, rich = rich, mantel = mant)
  }
  cells <- expand.grid(kg = c("bacteria", "fungi"), soil = names(SOILS), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  R <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(nrow(cells)), function(i) { set.seed(20261016 + i)   
    run_cell(cells$kg[i], cells$soil[i]) }, mc.cores = CORES)
  for (k in c("comp", "joint", "rich", "mantel"))
    write.csv(do.call(rbind, lapply(R, `[[`, k)), file.path(OUT, sprintf("trait_%s.csv", k)), row.names = FALSE)
  ## collinearity at species level
  sp <- data.frame(Distance = tr$Distance, Segetal = tr$Segetal, Nitrogen = tr$EllenN, Light = tr$EllenL,
                   SRL = tr$SRL, RDMC = tr$RDMC, RootShoot = tr$RootShoot); sp <- sp[complete.cases(sp), ]
  vif <- sapply(JOINT, function(v) 1 / (1 - summary(lm(as.formula(paste(v, "~ .")), data = sp[, JOINT]))$r.squared))
  write.csv(data.frame(trait = names(vif), VIF = vif), file.path(OUT, "trait_vif.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(OUT, "sessionInfo.txt"))
  message("done")
}

TRAIT_FILE <- file.path(CODE_DIR, "species_traits.csv")          # Table S1 traits
TREE_FILE  <- file.path(CODE_DIR, "weeds_wheat_VPM2_WP_S3.tre")   # V.PhyloMaker2 tree (rebuilt if the package is installed)
TRAIT_DIR  <- file.path(SUPP_DIR, "trait_models")
if (!file.exists(file.path(TRAIT_DIR, "trait_joint.csv")))
  trait_models(MATRIX_DIR, TRAIT_FILE, TREE_FILE, TRAIT_DIR, NPERM = 999, CORES = 4)   # [INT 8]
comp <- read.csv(file.path(TRAIT_DIR, "trait_comp.csv"))
stopifnot(abs(comp$F[comp$kingdom == "fungi" & comp$trait == "Distance" &
                     comp$soil == "Cereal-dominated (AF193)"] - 2.992) < 0.01)
knitr::kable(comp, digits = 3)
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(TRAIT_DIR, "trait_joint.csv")), digits = 3)    # joint R2 vs species-level null
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(TRAIT_DIR, "trait_rich.csv")), digits = 3)     # richness on species means
knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(TRAIT_DIR, "trait_mantel.csv")), digits = 3)
```
